articleTitle: Data-Driven Risk Assessment Early-Warning Model for Power System Transmission Congestions
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Power, Energy and Electrical Engineering (CPEEE)
abstract: With the continuous development of renewable energy in modern power systems, the balance between the power supply and demand side become more volatile, which may cause potential power system transmission congestions. Traditional risk assessment in the power system static security analysis area always uses the power flow model-based method, which cannot address all the possible operation scenarios. Therefore, a novel machine learning (ML) based data-driven risk assessment model for early-warning of power system transmission congestion is proposed in this paper. The proposed model can make full use of the power system historical operation data as well as the measurement of the current time step, which can be used in real-time for early-warning of the power system transmission congestion in advance. A feature selection method called Max-Relevance and Min-Redundancy (mRMR), is adopted to reduce the calculation burden of the ML model. Numerical tests are performed on a regional power grid of France. The proposed data-driven risk assessment model can accurately predict the risk conditions under normal operation, single and multiple component outage scenarios, over 93.3%. The result validates that our model can be used for real-time early-warning of power system transmission congestions.

articleTitle: Operator-based Robust Nonlinear Vibration Control System for A Flexible Arm with Double-sided SMA
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Power, Energy and Electrical Engineering (CPEEE)
abstract: The nonlinear vibration control system for a flexible arm using shape memory alloy (SMA) is discussed in this paper. The dynamic model of the flexible arm with SMA actuator is described. For considering the effect of hysteresis nonlinearity, an operator-based nonlinear control scheme is introduced to satisfy stability of the nonlinear control system. Simultaneously, the tracking performance is considered by designed n-times feedback loops based on operator theory. And, the desired vibration control performance can be obtained by the designed nonlinear control scheme. Finally, numerical simulations are conducted to verify the effectiveness of the designed control system.

articleTitle: Cooperative Optimal Scheduling of Interconnected Transmission-distribution-micro Power System
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Power, Energy and Electrical Engineering (CPEEE)
abstract: With the increasing penetration of renewable energy generation (REG) (i.e. wind power) and energy storage system (ESS) connected to the active distribution network (ADN), which breaks the traditional transmission-distribution-micro (TG -ADN-MG) grid hierarchical operation pattern. ADN is the intermediate link between transmission grid (TG) and microgrid (MG), based on the correlation and interaction between TG, ADN and MG, a unit commitment (UC) decision-making model of the synergestic TG-ADN-MG power system is proposed in this paper, based on the meticulous modeling of TG-ADN-MG scheduling, by introducing the analytical target cascading (ATC) algorithm, the power system at three layers are taken as different stakeholders, through the tie-line exchange power equivalent to the virtual generator and virtual load to achieve decoupled model, and synergetic source-network-load schedule of a complex system is realized. Concurrently, to enhance the capability of each layer of active momentum in the TG, ADN and MG to deal with wind power uncertainty, through the synergistic optimization of the decision-making variable of each layer, the economic goal optimization and the resource complementarity of the whole interconnected system are realized. Finally, case studies on the modified IEEE 6-bus system verify the effectiveness of the proposed model and method.

articleTitle: GIS Fault Diagnosis Method Based on The Identification of SF6 Gas Decomposition Product Fault Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Power, Energy and Electrical Engineering (CPEEE)
abstract: The analysis of SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> gas decomposition components is the key to the fault diagnosis of GIS equipment in substations. In order to explore the fault information in the SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> gas decomposition products before the GIS failure, this paper proposes a GIS fault diagnosis method based on SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> gas decomposition product fault feature identification. Firstly, a model based on information entropy theory is proposed for SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> gas decomposition products, and the contribution of each feature is solved and ranked by using principal component analysis. Secondly, the fault diagnosis model of support vector machine algorithm is introduced to achieve GIS fault discrimination. After comparison and validation, it is shown that the proposed method can effectively improve the GIS fault identification rate.

articleTitle: PV Hosting Capacity Estimation in Low Voltage Feeders Through Bayesian Statistical Inference
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Power, Energy and Electrical Engineering (CPEEE)
abstract: PV hosting capacity provides utilities the knowledge of the maximum amount of solar installations possible to accommodate in low voltage grids such that no operational problems arise. As the quantification of the hosting capacity requires data collection, grid modelling, and often time-consuming simulations, simplified estimations for large-scale applications are of interest. In this paper, Bayesian statistical inference is applied to estimate the hosting capacities of more than 5000 real feeders in Austria. The results show that the hosting capacity of 95% of the total feeders can be estimated with a mean error below 20% by only having knowledge of a random sample of 5%. Moreover, the hosting capacity estimation at a regional level shows a maximum error below 9%, also relying on a random sample of 5% of the total feeders. Furthermore, the approach proposed provides a methodology to assess new parameters aiming to improve the accuracy of the hosting capacity estimation at a feeder level.

articleTitle: A Synchronized Boost Converter for Low Power Photo Voltaic Harvesting with Practical Design Considerations
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Power, Energy and Electrical Engineering (CPEEE)
abstract: The objective of this research is to address low power photovoltaic (PV) harvesting issues and to develop a new power loss reduction methodology to improve the efficiency and output voltage concurrently. The output impedance of a PV is non-constant, and it changes in a nonlinear fashion which makes it a challenge to match the load to the PV cell impedance for efficiency regulation. Equally important is to avoid decreasing the output voltage of the module during an overcast. This creates a challenge to ensure a maximum power transfer and hence, degrades the efficiency. This paper presents a systematic approach to develop more efficient solar power conversion topologies to improve the output power, efficiency, output voltage and voltage conversion efficiency concurrently with a negligible impact on the reliability in Continuous Current Mode (CCM). To verify and validate the analysis and theory of the proposed topology, four prototypes were tested experimentally. The proposed circuit and approach outperform the current low power harvesting in terms of efficiency (83.1%) and output voltage.

articleTitle: Energy Management Strategy of Fuel Cell Backup Power Systems Based on Model Predictive Control
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Power, Energy and Electrical Engineering (CPEEE)
abstract: Due to the noise of diesel engine backup power systems, serious environmental pollution, and the inability to provide uninterrupted power supply, the backup power system of proton exchange membrane fuel cells has gradually attracted the attention of the industry. This article mainly focuses on a backup power system consisting of two fuel cells and lithium-ion batteries as the research object and proposes an energy management strategy based on model predictive control (MPC). MPC, under the constraints of fuel cell output power and output power increment, takes system hydrogen consumption as the objective function to solve the optimal power distribution between fuel cell and lithium-ion battery. Finally, MPC is compared with state machine energy management strategy by simulation. The results show that the energy management strategy based on MPC reduces hydrogen consumption by 18.83% and improves the overall efficiency of the fuel cell by 3.05%.

articleTitle: Comparing Armature Windings for a 10 MW Fully Superconducting Synchronous Wind Turbine Generator
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Power, Energy and Electrical Engineering (CPEEE)
abstract: Defining the armature winding in a fully superconducting generator means to make a fundamental design decision. Especially when using High Temperature Superconductors (HTS), this decision becomes more challenging, because the design has to comply with the general machine design constraints and the behaivor of the superconductor, which can contradict each other.This paper aims to introduce four different fully superconducting machine designs with different armature windings. Therefore, an integer slot distributed winding, a one and a two layer concentrated winding and an airgap winding, are investigated. For each winding a generator design is presented. By using FEM, the field distribution is calculated, which enables to estimate of the AC losses in order to make the overall performance of the four different machine designs becomes comparable.

articleTitle: Fault Location for Coaxial Cables Based on Broadband Impedance Spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Power, Energy and Electrical Engineering (CPEEE)
abstract: Fast and accurate location of cable fault is the key to ensure the safe and stable operation of the cable line and improve the reliability of the power supply. The broadband impedance spectroscopy (BIS) has provided a new method for cable fault location. Based on the relative research, this paper presents a method for cable fault location on the basis of the impedance spectroscopy. An integral transform (IT) algorithm is developed to transform the frequency-dependent impedance spectroscopy to a spatial domain function, and a location function is also promoted to achieve the fault location. The validity of the method is also verified by experiments performed on 10kV XLPE cables. The results show that the method proposed in this paper can be used to locate the cable fault, and the directions for future research is also presented.

articleTitle: HVDC Fault detection and Identification in monopolar topology using deep learning
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Power, Energy and Electrical Engineering (CPEEE)
abstract: Fault detection, identification(classification), and isolation are very important to ensure continuous power transmission in a power grid system. Fast and accurate methods are thus very critical for fault diagnosis in power systems. Many research papers attempted different learning methods in this area, and the focus was either on a subset of the aspects or only on the critical asset faults. The key results from some of the relevant ones are taken up for comparison. This paper describes the novel technical results in detecting and identifying all types of AC and DC faults in the HVDC station by using a fully convolutional neural network (FCNN) deep learning algorithm. The performance is evaluated with an experiment on symmetrical monopolar HVDC station simulated in Power Systems Computer-Aided Design (PSCAD). The novel significance of the results includes applying the learned knowledge from one station to validate on the other station data, the quick time to detect and identify faults, the confusion matrix, classification reports with probability of 99.24% for detection and 97.73% for identification, False alarm rate of 1.35%, and zero percent missed faults. The adaptability of the trained model from the learned knowledge to schematically related HVDC stations is discussed.

articleTitle: Research on Sequential Charging Control Strategy Considering Charging Continuity of Electric Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Power, Energy and Electrical Engineering (CPEEE)
abstract: firstly, this paper establishes the disordered charging model of electric vehicle, and establishes the objective function from the perspective of safe operation of power grid to calculate the expected charging load of electric vehicle. On the premise of considering the charging continuity of electric vehicle users, the control strategy of orderly charging of electric vehicles is designed. Based on the control strategy, the charging load models of different models of electric vehicles are optimized, and the operation benefits of power grid and the economic benefits of electric vehicle users before and after optimization are analyzed. Finally, through the case analysis, it further shows that the control strategy can not only ensure the continuous charging of electric vehicle users, but also improve the power grid operation efficiency and reduce the power consumption cost of electric vehicle users, and has the effect of peak shaving and valley filling.

Author Keywords: Cut the peak and fill the valley

articleTitle: Daily Peak Load Demand Forecast Considering Weather Conditions
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Power, Energy and Electrical Engineering (CPEEE)
abstract: The authors have proposed a prediction method that combines multiple regression analysis, which is a statistical method, and random forest, which is a machine learning method. The proposed method has applied to the prediction of daily peak load demand. In this paper, we compare the meteorological data using not only the past temperature, humidity, and solar radiation but also wind direction/volume, weather, etc

articleTitle: Peak Shaving Effect of Power-to-Gas in Robust Energy Dispatching
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Power, Energy and Electrical Engineering (CPEEE)
abstract: The remarkable growth of gas-fired units application has made natural gas the main fuel for power generation, so the supply of natural gas for electricity should be given enough attention. In addition, due to the increasing popularity of renewable energy (RE) in the electrical system (ES), the security of natural gas networks is under more risk. With the increasingly introduction to serve as storage in the form of fuels, power-to-gas (PtG) has been regarded as an excellent consumer of RE. However, its load adjustment function is still uncovered. To explore the potential of power-to-gas, a two-stage robust energy dispatch model is proposed in this paper, which takes into account the peak shaving effect of power-to-gas in both ES and natural gas network (NGN). Moreover, an improved Benders decomposition methodology introducing virtual constraints is proposed to give the optimization. In the case study, the deterministic and robust scenarios are compared. Finally, the peak shaving effect of PtG on the demand of IES is proved by the operation strategy, and the operation cost reduction is validated through the growth of unit utilization. The results show that the cost increases by 9.83% under the bad fluctuation scenario comparing to the deterministic scenario, and the utilization rate of PtG increases by 43.41%.

articleTitle: A Study on the Effectiveness of Detection of Unbalanced Datasets Based on Faster R-CNN
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Power, Energy and Electrical Engineering (CPEEE)
abstract: In the Faster R-CNN target detection task, to address the problem of how the unbalanced distribution of different kinds of datasets affects the recognition effect of the model, a research scheme is proposed to train the model using two different ratios of dataset combination, the two ratios are 1:1 and 1:2 respectively.In this paper, two kinds of objects in electrical equipment, anti-vibration hammer and insulator, are taken as the research objects, and each type of dataset After data processing, the data sets are combined according to the two different ratios set, and then put into the model for training to get the recognition effect. The experimental results show that at Epoch=40,000, the AP(the explanation is shown in TABLE I) of the trained model is much higher for the categories with a small proportion of data than for the categories with a large proportion of data when the ratio of the data sets of anti-vibration hammer and insulator is 1:2 or 2:1, and the AP of the model trained by unbalanced data distribution is unstable compared with the AP of the model trained by the ratio of the two categories of data sets of 1:1. In the actual detection task, it is easy to cause "false detection" or "missed detection". Based on the data unbalance problem, we propose data processing methods such as undersampling and oversampling of the dataset.

articleTitle: A Non-inverting Transformerless Semi-Quadratic Buck-Boost Converter
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Power, Energy and Electrical Engineering (CPEEE)
abstract: This paper proposes a semi-quadratic buck-boost converter that demonstrates a wider voltage conversion range, especially in boost mode. In comparison with the conventional buck-boost converter, this topology has continuous input and output current waveforms, being so beneficial when it comes to real-world applications. The proposed converter, additionally, is common-grounded, meaning that the polarity of the input voltage is the same as the polarity of the output voltage. Regarding the voltage and current stresses, the suggested converter has better performance in comparison with the structures having nearly the same conversion ratio, and this results in having semiconductor devices with lower on-resistance and, accordingly, lower conduction losses. The operating principle, design procedure, comparison with the other related topologies, and efficiency analysis are separately investigated and discussed. Eventually, to confirm the validity of the introduced converter, the simulation results are compared with the theoretically calculated values.

articleTitle: Scheduling Optimization Strategy for Communication Queues of Adjustable Load Interactive Services
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Power, Energy and Electrical Engineering (CPEEE)
abstract: Under the traditional communication architecture, in order to guarantee the service quality of demand response business communication transmission, an adjustable load business flow model is analyzed and established, and the transmission delay characteristics are analyzed. Based on this, a fuzzy control theory is proposed to optimize the weighted fair queue. The communication queue scheduling strategy of the scheduling algorithm. The algorithm can dynamically adjust the queue weights according to the real-time indicators of network monitoring. Its effectiveness in ensuring the quality of service requirements of various DR services has been verified in the communication network simulation environment built by OMNeT++ software .

articleTitle: Wireless Power Transmission Circuit and System Design
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Power, Energy and Electrical Engineering (CPEEE)
abstract: Wireless technology opens a wide range of research opportunities in all areas of electrical science, particularly in the electrical power sector. Nonetheless, it grows richer with each addition and change made by scientists and researchers. This entire project is based on Wireless Power Transmission systems, whose ultimate purpose is to transmit power in a uniform gain in a registered region. To accomplish this purpose, first, a schematic diagram was designed which has two parts. The first part is for transferring the power and the second part is for receiving the power. The power transferring part is modified as Antenna and the receiver part is Rectenna and both the antenna and rectenna were designed in CST software. A receiver circuit was designed for delivering the power which was designed in ADS software. The receiver circuit was constructed in three individual sections. They are antenna circuit, rectifier circuit, and buck converter. The resonance frequency of the system is 2.4GHz and after completing the analysis we get the output of (5.655 to 4.95) V DC in rectangular shaped patch antenna and (5.573 to 4.86) V DC in circular shaped patch antenna in (2 to 60) meter. In addition, we tried to figure out which antenna provides better output by differentiate the shape of the antenna. The project’s primary goal is to transmit power to a focused area and also determine the estimated cost, health concerns, and repercussions in terms of social, political, and technological factors.

articleTitle: A ZVS Buck/Boost Converter With Coupled-Filter-Inductor
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Power, Energy and Electrical Engineering (CPEEE)
abstract: This paper proposes a zero-voltage-switching (ZVS) Buck/Boost converter (BBC) based on a coupled-filter-inductor. An auxiliary circuit is introduced to realize ZVS operation for the main switches. Compared with traditional ZVS converters, the additional inductor of the auxiliary circuit is eliminated. Besides, in the traditional ZVS implementation method, the existence of the auxiliary circuit current causes a large ripple of the input source current, which affects the life of the battery connected to the low voltage port. In the proposed BBC, since the current of the magnetizing inductor is divided into two parts, which respectively flow through the auxiliary circuit and the main switches, the auxiliary circuit current will not affect the input source current. Thus, the low voltage port has a smaller current ripple. Finally, a 450W BBC experimental prototype is built for experimental verification, and the results show that this method can achieve the ZVS operation of the main switch, thereby improving the system efficiency.

articleTitle: Particle Filter with Weight Adjustment and Its Application on Heat Exchange Process with Time Delay and Large Sensor Noise
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Power, Energy and Electrical Engineering (CPEEE)
abstract: Particle filter has been popularized and used for solving estimation problems since the early 1990s. Extensive research has advanced the generic particle filter to improve the performance and applicability in various ways. A variant of the generic particle filter algorithm is shown in this paper. The particle filter variant re-adjusts the calculation method of the particle weight during the update stage, where the normalized exponential weight instead of the original absolute particle weight is used to deal with the problem of unavailability of reliable weights when encountering large realistic noises. Simulation shows the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: A Modified Data-driven Power Flow Model for Power Estimation with Incomplete Bus Data
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Power, Energy and Electrical Engineering (CPEEE)
abstract: For power estimation in power systems, the power flow formulation is the most commonly used method. Data-driven approach is a newly proposed technology, unlike traditional model-driven power flow calculations, it can bypass circuit parameters and environmental variables to obtain results from global bus data. However, with the development of renewable energy, more complex power grids make it difficult to obtain complete data and reduce performance. Therefore, this paper proposes a method of estimating power from incomplete bus data. The method is based on a modified data-driven power flow model, and its core is to derive and induce a regressive model through the physical model. The simulation results on IEEE standard bus 30 show that this method has higher accuracy than other models in incomplete bus data power estimation.

articleTitle: Research on Setting Value Detection of Relay Protection Device Based on Wide Area Recording Information
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Power, Energy and Electrical Engineering (CPEEE)
abstract: In this paper, a new method is proposed to study the setting value detection of relay protection device based on wide area recording information after the occurrence of power line faults, which mainly solves the problems of low efficiency and poor pertinence of periodic detection of relay protection device.The system realized automatic value detection of wide area recording information of relay protection in power system. It used Python and C++ language joint programming. First, it used Python to parse Excel file of setting value sheet and HDR file of recording, and wrote their information into a unified XML file type. A setting value check is performed and the checked condition is written to a new XML file. Finally, Python is used to convert the XML file of the above detection situation into Word file or PDF file for reading. The system has achieved good results in trial operation in the dispatching center of state Grid Electric Power Company.

articleTitle: Design of High Voltage and Large Current Trigger Source for Trigger Vacuum Switch
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Power, Energy and Electrical Engineering (CPEEE)
abstract: The field breakdown type triggered vacuum switch has been widely used in the field of pulse power technology because of its advantages of high rated voltage and high rated current. However, compared with the surface breakdown type triggered vacuum switch, the field breakdown type triggered vacuum switch has higher requirements on the trigger pulse. The widely used trigger source has low trigger voltage steepness and low trigger current, leading to large trigger delay and discreteness. Therefore, the design of a high voltage and high current trigger source based on full wave voltage doubling rectifier circuit and low variable ratio pulse transformer is crucial for the field breakdown type TVS. The trigger source first charges high voltage to the energy storage capacitor through the voltage doubling rectifier circuit, and then discharges to the trigger gap through the low-variable ratio pulse transformer. Thus high steep trigger voltage and large trigger current pulse can be obtained. This paper introduces the working principle of the trigger source, analyzes and designs the voltage doubling rectifier circuit and pulse transformer in detail, and verifies the feasibility and effectiveness of the design scheme through experiments.

articleTitle: Online Trading Platform for Power Company Suppliers Based on Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Power, Energy and Electrical Engineering (CPEEE)
abstract: Facing the new situation of gradually liberalizing the power generation and consumption plan, accelerating the construction of the spot market and the rapid development of the energy internet, new requirements are put forward for the power market trading system. The security of the power market trading system is not only related to the fairness of market competition, but also related to the security of the power grid. Therefore, in order to establish a reliable power online trading system, this article constructs a decentralized traceability system based on the idea of blockchain. By storing and verifying the data of electricity supply chain on kadelima distributed peer-to-peer network and ethereum, a user data query service system is proposed.

articleTitle: Integrated Energy System Regional Grid Energy Storage Auxiliary Frequency Regulation and Energy Storage Configuration Method
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Power, Energy and Electrical Engineering (CPEEE)
abstract: In recent years, the large-scale promotion of new energy technologies and electric vehicles, the continuous development of energy storage technology, the rapid decline in the cost of energy storage, plus the value of energy storage for increasing the power system's peak and frequency regulation capacity and spatial flexibility in time has a very significant role, the promotion of energy storage in the power system will certainly be the future trend. At the system level in the integrated energy region, the overall control strategy for energy storage assisted frequency regulation can be divided into a control strategy where energy storage is involved in primary frequency regulation alone and a compensating control strategy where the energy storage output is adjusted according to the unit output. At the device level in the integrated energy area, the voltage and current double closed-loop control strategy and the PQ control strategy are used to achieve precise control of the overall input and output power of the energy storage system according to the circuit structure of the bi-directional DC/DC converter and inverter and the physical constraints of the control object.

articleTitle: Failure Analysis of Metal Oxide Surge Arrester Blocks Based on Repetitive Charge Transfer Rating Verification Test
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Power, Energy and Electrical Engineering (CPEEE)
abstract: Surge arresters play a vital role in protecting power system equipment. With its nonlinear characteristics, surge arrester limits the surge voltages in the system to acceptable range and prolongs the life of power system equipment. Surge arrester is made of individual zinc oxide blocks that are stacked in series parallel combinations in order to achieve the required specification. They are categorized into distribution class and station class, depending upon their application. In the latest edition of IEC 60099-4, a new test named test to verily the repetitive charge transfer rating is introduced in order to classify the blocks. The test uses charge, to classify the blocks instead of energy, that was used in the earlier existed long duration impulse withstand test. In this paper, analysis is done on the types of failures of various designation of blocks occurred during the test to verify the repetitive charge transfer rating.

articleTitle: Research on Application Value of Regenerative Electric Heating Load Based on Big Data Classification
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Power, Energy and Electrical Engineering (CPEEE)
abstract: The load resource utilization has become an important way to achieve the goal of "Chinese double carbon". As a high-quality interruptible load, the regenerative electric heating load has obvious application value on the power grid side. Based on the application of the big data classification method to reclassify the regenerative electric heating load, this paper comprehensively analyzes its operation characteristics and influencing factors. By using the hybrid decision tree method, the load models have been built. In addition, the application value of regenerative electric heating load in promoting wind power accommodation and reducing load peak-valley difference has been studied. The results show that through the pertinent adjustment of influencing factors, the operating mode of regenerative electric heating load can be flexibly adjusted to improve its application value on the power grid side.

articleTitle: Design of a High-Performance Multi-Channel DC-DC Power Supply
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Power, Energy and Electrical Engineering (CPEEE)
abstract: This paper designs a high-performance digital power to improve the existing digital power's precision and speed of dynamic response. The design is a multi-channel output system implemented on a field programmable gate array (FPGA) facility. According to the high computational capability and parallel processing characteristic of the FPGA, the system which adopts the parallel ADC and PID controller to complete a closed-loop control, can implement the high precision DPWM at a low system clock. Furthermore, the design improves the traditional synchronous BUCK module by increasing a drive enhancement circuit and a RCD snubber circuit to enhance the stability of the system, reduce power loss and realize high-speed dynamic response. The system can reach 0.02% output accuracy, the ripple voltage below 5mV and microsecond level dynamic response.

articleTitle: Analyzing the Spinning Reserve Involved in SOS/TVS with the Transient Structure in Multi-Machine Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Power, Energy and Electrical Engineering (CPEEE)
abstract: The spinning/rotational reserve includes the load reserve and the breakdown reserve, relating to the sudden generator outages, causing the transient structure with the power unbalance, concerning the small-oscillation stability (SOS) or the transient voltage stability (TVS). Depending on the power plant’s locations and the generator output power, a sudden generator outage may bring a problem of SOS or some more severe oscillations with the matching power generation load levels leading to the emergency contingency problems of transient stability, even may cause the loss of synchronism in power system. Using the transient potential and kinetic energies in combination with the transient voltage stability estimation, we propose a formula to determine the values of breakdown reserve stability estimation (BRSE) for assessing the power plant’s transient structures in case of sudden generator outages. This paper also proposes an algorithm modeling the power network’s non-linearity caused by the transient oscillation concerning a sudden generator outage occurring in one of the power plants operated in a multi-machine power system. The typical results are shown in this paper to prove the advantages of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Study of Diesel Combining with Vaporizing Ethanol via a Carburetor for a Diesel-engine Generator
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Power, Energy and Electrical Engineering (CPEEE)
abstract: Nowadays, diesel prices in Thailand are increasing steadily due to crude oil market volatility. To reduce the diesel consumption, the research aims to study the performance and emission characteristics of a diesel-engine generator fueled with vaporizing ethanol via a carburetor combining with diesel on a dual fuel mode. The vaporizing ethanol is changed by increasing main jet diameter from 0.8 to 1.0 mm combined with diesel injection on the dual fuel mode, as compared with only diesel mode at a constant speed of 3,000 rpm and different loads. Results shows that the addition of vaporizing ethanol by adding main jet diameter combining with diesel led to the reduction of engine performance. The exhaust emissions, especially nitric oxide and black smoke, were reduced with vaporizing ethanol increased, but there was the increase of carbon dioxide and carbon monoxide. The research found that the use of main jet diameter at 0.8 mm in vaporizing ethanol combining with diesel resulted the addition of diesel saving to 47%, and brake thermal efficiency was dropped only by 2%. Nitric oxide and black smoke emissions were decreased up to 12%, while carbon dioxide and carbon monoxide releases were only slightly increased.

articleTitle: Examination of Improvement of Supply Stability by Introducing Wind Power Generation in Disaster-Robust Zero Energy Vehicle(D-ZEV)
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Power, Energy and Electrical Engineering (CPEEE)
abstract: In this paper, the modeling of the new D-ZEV will be analyzed as well as the simulation. The accuracy of the improved PV maximum power point tracking algorithm is compared with the conventional method. In order to be more realistic, a wind simulation model consisting of four types of wind speed was created in the simulation. The study also designed a charge/discharge control system for the battery to ensure the stability of the overall system. The focus of this paper is on the comparison before and after the improvement of the PV maximum power point tracking algorithm and the analysis of the stability of the overall system supply.

articleTitle: Influence of Down-shifting Films on Solar Cells
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Power, Energy and Electrical Engineering (CPEEE)
abstract: The luminescent down-shifting (DS) process effectively generates more electron-hole pairs in the depletion zone of solar cells at short wavelength photons. The Ce-doped YAG phosphor particles of 15-20 µm are separated via conventional filtration method and mixed with different concentrations (0.3%, 0.5%, 0.8%, and 1%) in ethylene-vinyl acetate (EVA) to make luminescent DS films, which is used for packaging the polycrystalline silicon (pc-Si) solar cells. The photoluminescent intensity of YAG: Ce particles, the transmission of luminescent DS films with different concentrations, and the performance of packaged solar cells have been analyzed. Experimental results show that a higher concentration of phosphor particles in EVA raises the surface reflection, which negatively influences the solar cell’s performance. When the particles range is fixed (15-20 µm), the luminescent DS films with the mass ratio of phosphors to EVA 10:0.03 have the highest transmission. The biggest improvement in the conversion efficiency of solar cells after packaging is due to the 10:0.08 mass ratio of phosphor in EVA. This research might be helpful for the photovoltaic industry in the future.

articleTitle: A Knowledge Transfer Approach for Online PEMFC Degradation prediction with Uncertainty Quantification
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Power, Energy and Electrical Engineering (CPEEE)
abstract: Proton Exchange Membrane Fuel Cells (PEMFCs) are a key challenger for the world’s future clean and renewable energy solution. Yet, fuel cells are susceptible to operating conditions and hydrogen impurities, leading to performance loss over time in service. Hence, performance degradation prediction is gaining attention recently for fuel cell system reliability. In this work, we present a knowledge transfer approach for online voltage drop prediction. A dual-path convolution neural network is proposed to extract linearity and non-linearity from historical data and performs multi-steps ahead prediction with uncertainty quantification. Online voltage prediction is then evaluated with and without knowledge transfer using two different PEMFC datasets. Results indicate that our proposed approach with transfer knowledge can predict the voltage drop accurately with a small uncertainty range compared to the conventional approach.

articleTitle: Controller Chip Design of A Simple Switched-Coupled-Inductor Boost DC-AC Inverter
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Power, Energy and Electrical Engineering (CPEEE)
abstract: This work presents the design and implementation of the controller chip used in a simple switched-coupled-inductor inverter (SCII) for the boost DC-AC conversion/regulation. In the power-conversion part, there are two sub-circuits as: switched-coupled-inductor booster and half-bridge DC-link in a cascade between supply Vs and output Vo, so as to obtain the AC output range: +(1+nD)Vs/(1-D) ~ -nVs (n: turn ratio of coupled inductor, D: ON ratio cycle of inductor-charging). To achieve the boost DC-AC, the control part consists of phase generator and sinusoidal pulse-width-modulation (SPWM) block, and the chip internal circuit is made through pre/post-layout design via Cadence. By the assistance of Chip Design and Implementation Center, this control part is practically fabricated on a real chip (D35-106B-E0027, TSMC 0.35μm 2P4M, 3.3V, 2.146mW, max 100kHz). When n=6, D=0.42, this SCII performs the conversion from DC 24V to AC 100Vrms, 60Hz. Finally, the prototype circuit is implemented, and several cases are illustrated to show the practicality.

articleTitle: Analysis of Symmetrical Components AND Balanced earth faults in distribution transformers
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Power, Energy and Electrical Engineering (CPEEE)
abstract: The objective of this study is to show the analysis and behavior of symmetrical components and balanced faults in power transformers. Thus, the symmetric component methods solve directly the distribution of voltages and currents, allowing the correct verification of the procedure and the influence of earth circuit faults with the neutral point in distribution transformers. Therefore, the symmetric component analysis procedure has an innovative contribution to the determination of problem solving that solves practical cases and allows to determine the unbalanced failure analysis.

articleTitle: Optimal Control Strategy of Temperature Control Equipment Based on CPS System
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Power, Energy and Electrical Engineering (CPEEE)
abstract: Aiming at the characteristics of temperature control equipment with good energy saving and demand response potential, a temperature control equipment energy consumption control system based on the cyber physical system (CPS) architecture is proposed. Based on the two-tier architecture of a typical CPS system, the unit level realizes the dynamic information perception, standardized information modeling and control of temperature control equipment through the intelligent energy-using terminal; the system-level implements multiple information fusion and edge computing through the intelligent energy-using gateway to achieve Energy efficiency analysis, energy efficiency diagnosis and coordinated control of multiple devices for residential temperature control equipment. Relying on the proposed interactive architecture and CPS model, using the relevant information sensed by the CPS unit, at the CPS decision-making level, an optimized control strategy for temperature control equipment based on cloud model theory is proposed. The consumption has dropped significantly.

articleTitle: Fault Analysis and Rectification of Traction Removal for CRH5 EMU
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Power, Energy and Electrical Engineering (CPEEE)
abstract: As an important component of traction system, TCU (Traction Control Unit) is one of the most important factors of driving safety. Recently, TCU of CRH5 EMU(Electric Multiple Units) frequently reports fault information such as CAN communication interference and ALCA board failure. In order to solve this problem, this paper analyzes the principle of traction system and TCU internal board circuit, and carries out the location test of interference source and interference path, theoretical analysis and simulation verification of interference mechanism, to find out the cause of electromagnetic interference in TCU system. Based on the circuit structure of traction converter, a rectification scheme for traction removal fault is proposed, which lays a technical foundation for solving the problem of electromagnetic interference in TCU system.

articleTitle: Research on Power Frequency Withstand Characteristics of MOV Resistor Based on EMTP
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Power, Energy and Electrical Engineering (CPEEE)
abstract: Considering the current simulation or experimental research on the impulse withstand of arrester resistor, most of the impulse excitation is 2 ms square wave impulse current or 8 / 20 μ The P-G simulation model of metal oxide varistors is built by using ATP-EMTP simulation software, and the power frequency withstand characteristics of 500kV varistors with different numbers are simulated, The results show that: under the same working conditions, there is a big difference between the new and old resistance values, the test voltage and current waveforms are basically the same, the withstand time is close, and the withstand voltage peak is close.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Ultrasonic Stress Detection Method for Insulation Defects of High Voltage Switchgear
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Power, Energy and Electrical Engineering (CPEEE)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of single technical means and difficult quantitative analysis in the process of insulation defect detection of high voltage switchgear, in this paper, the effects of bubble and crack on the stress distribution of insulation diaphragm under electric field were studied by finite element method. On this basis, an ultrasonic stress detection method for insulation defects of high voltage switchgear was proposed. A detection system in this study was constructed, and the artificial simulated defect samples placed in the high voltage switchgear were also tested. Our study show that the average error of defect size was 0.24mm. The experimental results show that this method can effectively detect and quantitatively analyze the insulation defects in high voltage switchgear, and the detection results have high accuracy.

articleTitle: In-depth CFD Analysis and Verification of Vortex Generator Installed 2.3MW Horizontal Axis Wind Turbine
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Power, Energy and Electrical Engineering (CPEEE)
abstract: The effect of VG calculated through computational Huid dynamics (CFD) on the blade of a 2.3MW wind turbine was compared with the supervisory control and data acquisition (SCADA) data. VGs are essentially small fins that are installed toward the root of the wind turbine blade to reduce airflow separation. Separation flow on the wind turbine blade suction surface were captured by the Reynolds-averaged Navier-Stokes (RANS) steady flow simulation using general-purpose code, ANSYS CFX. Based on CFD, AEP calculation was performed through PROPID. VG attachment location tracking and actual attachment were performed through laser tracking, and attachment was performed within an error range of 4×10-4. Data during 2 months with and without VG attachment were analyzed. It has been validated that VG has a play of role to enhance significant aerodynamic performance. AEP calculated by PROPID predicted an increase of 0.81% total, while the measured AEP increases by 1.02% total. At the wind speed of rated power, increase rate of power was 2.80% in CFD analysis results, and was 4.83% in measured data, respectively.

articleTitle: Optimal Operation for Smart City with Model Predictive Control
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Power, Energy and Electrical Engineering (CPEEE)
abstract: In recent years, the concentration of the world's population in urban areas has become a big issue. Countermeasures to the problems brought about by the concentration of population in cities require the efficient management and use of energy and environmental measures. In the field of microgrids, model predictive control (MPC), which can determine the future behavior of a system by incorporating both predictions and updates of data, and can efficiently handle various types of system constraints, has been attracting attention. In this research, we show the effectiveness of the Model Predictive Control as an optimization problem in smart city by operating the system to minimize the total cost.

articleTitle: MEMS Electric Field Sensor with Biased Electrically Floating Cover to Measure Electric Field in Ionic Environments
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Power, Energy and Electrical Engineering (CPEEE)
abstract: Electric field measurement is widely applied in HVDC area. However, it is a challenge to measure dc electric field in ionic environment using a packaged sensor. When the sensor is packaged in an enclosure, the landing of charge particles from environment on the enclosure surface would give an off-setting electric field, and so cause measurement error. In this paper we propose a method to bias an electrically floating metal cover above the packaged sensor, to prevent ions landing on the package cover, while still being able to measure electric field external to the enclosure. Experimental results show that when the floating cover is pre-biased, ionic charge accumulation can be reduced and eliminated. The sensor sensitivity remains at 70 mV(kV/m)<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>, with and without ionic charge present in the environment.

articleTitle: Temperature Difference Monitoring Method for Metal Devices of Electrical Equipment by Visible Images and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Power, Energy and Electrical Engineering (CPEEE)
abstract: In this paper, ordinary visible images were used to measure the temperature difference between two metal devices that were used in electrical equipment and transmission lines. The temperature-difference experiments of three kinds of metal devices used in 110kV transmission lines were conducted for collecting their visible images with varying temperature differences in a sunlight environment. The machine learning (ML) technique was applied for modeling the relationship functions between visible image features and temperature differences. The results showed that the corresponding temperature difference of metal devices in these images could be well predicted by trained ML models. Larger illuminance of sunlight helped to obtain higher prediction accuracy. This method could be used for monitoring the abnormal temperature rise of metal parts in electrical equipment by comparing the temperatures of two different phases. It would provide a new choice for intelligent temperature monitoring in power systems, helping save costs and improve inspection efficiency.

articleTitle: Controller Chip Design of Dual-Clamped-Voltage Coupled-Inductor Switched-Capacitor Converter
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Power, Energy and Electrical Engineering (CPEEE)
abstract: In this work, the design and implementation of the controller chip is presented and applied to dual-clamped-voltage coupled-inductor switched-capacitor (DCISC) converter for step-up DC-DC conversion. In this system, the plant (i.e., power part) is composed of DCI booster and three-stage SC doubler, so as to attain the high-gain power conversion from DC 12V to DC 500V. In order to achieve the target, the controller (i.e., control part) is made up of non-overlapping circuit and pulse-width-modulation (PWM) block, and its chip internal circuit is designed in Cadence through pre/post-layout procedures. Then, with the assistance of Chip Design and Implementation Center (CIC), the controller is implemented on an IC chip: no. D35-106D-E0001, TSMC 0.35μm 2P4M, 1500×1500μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, 3.3V, 2.763mW, max frequency 50kHz, 18S/B. At the end, the prototype circuit of DCISC is realized, and also some experimental cases of high-gain DC-DC conversion are illustrated to show the practicality.

articleTitle: Optimization of Generator Dispatching Model Considering Load Demand Response Resources
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Power, Energy and Electrical Engineering (CPEEE)
abstract: As China starts to build a new power system with new energy as the main body, the difficulty of power grid dispatching is increasing day by day, further reform of the power market is imminent, and the role of power load demand response resources in the dynamic balance of power grid is gradually manifested. This paper takes the randomness of the generator and the operating constraints of the electric power system unit into consideration, by using probabilistic production simulation and day-ahead optimal dispatching method, it builds the day-ahead output model of the generator. Then, further including the objective function and constraint conditions, as well as demand response resources, a day-ahead optimization model of the electric power system has been built. Finally, an actual power grid in a certain area is taken as an example to verify the effectiveness of the model. It turns out that the model works well to solve the conditions of random shutdowns, and reduces the losses caused by power outages.

articleTitle: Adjustable Load Interactive Blockchain Interoperability Strategy Based on Reputation Value Promotion
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Power, Energy and Electrical Engineering (CPEEE)
abstract: In order to solve the security and credibility problems of contract signing and transactions in the electricity market, a solution based on the combination of blockchain technology and distributed load interaction is proposed. The matching characteristics of load interaction transaction and blockchain, and the design of node reputation value evaluation mechanism, based on this research on the user-side adjustable load distributed interaction interoperability strategy, three algorithms are used to compare the results of the calculation examples, and the algorithm is proved by the simulation results Reasonableness.

articleTitle: Study on Switching Overvoltage of 500kV Hydropower Station with GIL Outgoing Line
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Power, Energy and Electrical Engineering (CPEEE)
abstract: Due to the special location of hydropower station, it is often necessary to transfer electric energy to the outdoor switch station through a long gas insulated transmission line (GIL). Therefore, transient overvoltage will be formed in the operation process, which will affect the safe operation of the primary equipment connected with it, especially the transformer. In order to quantify the switching overvoltage of main transformer in hydropower station with Gil outgoing line, the distributed parameter model is established by using the electromagnetic transient analysis software ATP-EMTP. The influence of equipment operation, the number of outgoing lines, the length of connecting pipeline between transformer and Gil line, and the distance between arrester and high voltage winding on the switching overvoltage of main transformer in hydropower station with Gil outgoing line is simulated, the characteristics of switching overvoltage of main transformer are obtained. The analysis shows that the wave refraction and reflection during GIS operation is the main reason for the rise of switching overvoltage, and the overvoltage assessment should be carried out for the hydropower station with Gil outlet with complex structure.

articleTitle: Adaptive Coding Strategy for User-side Resource and Power Grid Interaction Service
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Power, Energy and Electrical Engineering (CPEEE)
abstract: Demand response (DR) continues to deepen the practice, the future needs to rely on highly reliable information interaction to support fine DR control. Aiming at the communication optimization problem of DR wireless communication, this paper designs a double-layer adaptive coding strategy based on real-time monitoring of signal-to-noise ratio and real-time acquisition of broadcast messages from DR master station on the premise of analyzing the quality of service requirements of all kinds of DR services. The proposed strategy uses adaptive precoding technology to optimize DR wireless communication, classifies the communication quality of service according to the specific period of time during the implementation of DR, and considers the computational cost introduced by the algorithm. The simulation results show that the strategy has a good optimization effect in the system bit error rate and processing delay control.

articleTitle: Research on Diffusion Mechanism of "Multi-station integration" Based on SIR Epidemic Model
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Power, Energy and Electrical Engineering (CPEEE)
abstract: The "digital economy" not only puts forward requirements for the modernization, innovation, transformation and upgrading of the power system, but also points out the direction for the development of "multi-station integration". This article focuses on the field of "multi-station integration" of power grid enterprises, considering the structural characteristics of the diffusion of the "multi-station integration" mode, using SIR epidemic model to collect and organize data on the interest relationship of the main body, and analyzing the structural characteristics among the stakeholders (provinces). The results show that: (1) the diffusion of "multi-station integration" in 31 provinces showing a general trend of the larger the diffusion rate of the spread province, the smaller the conflict rate, the stronger the diffusion capacity. (2) There are still unbalanced and insufficient phenomena in the diffusion of "multi-station integration" mode in 31 provinces.

articleTitle: Battery Degradation Modelling and Prediction with Combination of Machine Learning and Semi-empirical Methods
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Power, Energy and Electrical Engineering (CPEEE)
abstract: Battery energy storage systems (BESS) are being widely deployed as part of the energy transition. Accurate battery degradation modelling and prediction play an important role in BESS investment and revenue, planning and sizing, operational monitoring, and warranty check-ups. Complex operational behaviors and system variability make the battery degradation modelling and prediction more challenging. In this paper, we propose a novel methodology of combining a machine learning model with semi-empirical equations to have a robust state of health (SOH) estimation. Together with cycle decomposition analysis, this model can be deployed for real-time degradation analysis of BESS.

articleTitle: Explicit Analytical Approach for Electromagnetic Modeling of Arbitrary Pole Pair Induction Machines
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Power, Energy and Electrical Engineering (CPEEE)
abstract: In highly dynamic vehicle operation, the parameter of induction machines change significantly depending on the operating point. Furthermore, faulty machine behavior or aging effects cause parameter changes and asymmetric behavior. In order to save test bench capacities, these issues must be adressed by a corresponing simulation model. Simultaneously, comparatively short computation time is neccessary. The mentioned requirements are handled by a three phase analytical approach modeling stator and rotor windings explicitly. Arbitrary pole pairs are considered simplified using a newly proposed approximation function in magnetic transition areas. Iron losses and different machine faults are modeled according to known approaches. A real machines extended parameter set is used for model parametrization. Simulative validation is done by comparison to a commonly known model. Eventually testbench results show, that the proposed model is well suited for modeling the real machine. In future work the proposed model is used to improve development process of online parameter identification algorithms for aging or faulty induction machines.

articleTitle: Sustainable Design and LCA of non-RE PMSynRM with Bioplastic Rotor Shroud
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Power, Energy and Electrical Engineering (CPEEE)
abstract: The electric vehicle components should be audited from manufacturing to disposal to be aligned with the United Nations sustainable development goals. The electrical machines without rare-earth (RE) magnets will assure a much lower environmental impact. Non-RE designs will also reduce the cost and weight of the motor with a penalty on the performance. One of the most prominent non-RE magnet motor designs is the Synchronous Reluctance Motor (SynRM), where the rotor anisotropy is assured via flux barriers in the rotor quadrature direction. Held in place via iron bridges (aka. ribs), flux barriers will, in turn, impact the rotor saliency. As a remedy, the paper will report on a novel ribless rotor design accommodating bioplastic for the rotor structure design. The bioplastic rotor ribless machine will be compared to various state-of-the-art electrical machine concept designs on their merit on sustainability, performance, structural integrity, and the active parts packaging volume. The electrical machine designs are also presented with ferrite magnets to enhance the specific torque. Finally, rib less ferrite assisted SynRM rotor will be further optimized in material choice to arrive at a design solution with minimized environmental impact. As a guideline, the total CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> impact of this paper is also quantified in a separate section.

articleTitle: Net-Zero Intelligent Energy System: Road to a Successful Carbon Neutral Future
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Power, Energy and Electrical Engineering (CPEEE)
abstract: The road to carbon neutrality is challenging and requires both energy transformation and digital transformation for the future success. A novel net-zero intelligent energy system (NZIES) is proposed based on multi-energy integration, and a new analytic architecture is designed and proposed with NED transformation strategy model with E2E energy efficiency improvement, full life cycle carbon management and carbon/electricity trading collaboration. The energy pyramid methodology provides theoretical support for the planning and construction of intelligent energy system. Finally, a case study on net-zero smart campus including overall blueprint, phase conditions and planning paths for NZIES is introduced as the practical example for NZIES.

articleTitle: Enhanced State and Parameter Estimation within Reconfigurable Battery Systems for Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Power, Energy and Electrical Engineering (CPEEE)
abstract: Today’s electric vehicles commonly comprise battery management systems in which model-based functionalities are applied. To keep the incorporated models up to date state and parameter estimation is crucial, but only with sufficient excitation adequate estimates are achievable. In recent years, reconfigurable battery systems became more and more prominent in research, whereby switches allow to change the power path reversibly during operation. Within this work, the impact of switching actions of reconfigurable battery systems on state and parameter estimation is investigated. For this purpose, suitable switching patterns and strategies are introduced and their benefit on estimation accuracy is evaluated based on validation experiments. A reconfigurable battery pack consisting of twelve lithium-ion cells in mixed topology is excited by different current profiles whereby varying switching actions are applied. Results show that switching operation significantly improves the estimation accuracy, particularly in cases where the native current excitation is of low dynamics. Furthermore, a suitable threshold for situation-based switching is determined which uses the Goertzel algorithm to assess the current excitation.

articleTitle: Research on Imaging Technology of Ultrasonic Echo Applied to Live Detection of Switchgear Insulation Defects
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Power, Energy and Electrical Engineering (CPEEE)
abstract: The internal insulation defect is the main reason for the failure of high voltage switchgear. At present, there is a lack of effective technical means and methods for live detection of switchgear insulation defects. In this study, the artificial bee colony algorithm was improved to estimate the parameters of ultrasonic echo, then the imaging detection method of ultrasonic echo was proposed. Finally, the live detection system of switchgear based on ultrasonic echo imaging was constructed. Through test verification, it is concluded that: the improved artificial bee colony algorithm has high precision parameter estimation results, and the estimation error was less than 1%. Finally, the live detection system of switchgear based on ultrasonic echo imaging was applied in the field. The results show that: this system can fully reflect the internal defect morphology of switchgear insulation and can also meet the accuracy and real-time requirements of switchgear live detection system based on ultrasonic echo imaging.

articleTitle: Design and Characteristic Analysis of Microgrid and Mobile Energy Storage Link
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Power, Energy and Electrical Engineering (CPEEE)
abstract: For seamless switching between two operating modes of a single microgrid vehicle and power sharing in islanding mode of multiple microgrid vehicles. We first establish the mathematical model of virtual synchronous generator system, and apply the secondary frequency regulation strategy to pre-synchronization on the basis of achieving priority protection for important loads, and change the virtual inertia, damping coefficient and pre-synchronization link of virtual synchronous generator by adjusting the virtual impedance to achieve seamless switching between grid-connected and off-grid modes. On this basis, an adaptive virtual impedance strategy is proposed to realize the balanced power distribution of multi-vehicle parallel system in islanding mode. Ensuring power supply quality and uninterrupted power supply for important loads and non-stop operation of distribution network. Build a microgrid model in Matlab/simlink to verify the effectiveness of the control scheme.

articleTitle: Energy Optimization and Human Bio-Mechanical Performance Analysis Using Novel All Four Limbs Based Energy Harvester
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Power, Energy and Electrical Engineering (CPEEE)

authors.preferredName: K. M. E. L. N. Bandara

abstract: This paper presents a specifically-built novel all four limbs-based human energy harvester with bio-feedback and criteria to maximize human bio-mechanical energy output at a defined power level. The developed energy harvester decouples the human upper and lower limbs energy generation while giving a full-body workout. A Graphical User Interface was embedded to monitor the human rider's heart rate, respiratory rate, generated electrical energy, lower and upper limbs power in real-time. In the implemented energy maximization criteria, an optimum leg-to-hand power ratio was obtained. This optimum power ratio maximizes the rider's energy output at a defined power level. The output energy variations of untrained Sri Lankan citizens were acquired experimentally using pre-defined power levels and the maximum and minimum energy output were observed at 60W and 120W power levels for each test subject. Over 200W maximum electrical power output was achieved for an untrained Sri Lankan citizen by utilizing the energy harvester.

articleTitle: Power Forward Curve Model with Mitigated Swell Based on Constrained Least Square Error Approach
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Power, Energy and Electrical Engineering (CPEEE)
abstract: To construct a power forward curve (PFC), which is indispensable for decision-making such as pricing of electricity transactions, we propose a modeling method with relatively small error while satisfying the reasonable PFC requirements summarized in the previous study. In particular, we focus on the problem that the PFC obtained by the existing method, which simultaneously satisfies the smoothness and arbitrage-free conditions, tends to "swell" significantly when the price of electricity futures rises, and the fit deteriorates significantly, and propose a method to mitigate this problem. Specifically, using B-spline basis functions, we solve a constrained least-square-error-based optimization problem instead of minimizing the integral of squared curvature, which has been used in previous studies. The empirical study examines the errors between the realized spot prices and the PFCs using multiple futures products for different observation points, and finds that our method effectively mitigates the "swell" problem and is more accurate overall than the previous method. Furthermore, it is shown that the fit of the forward curve can be improved by, for example, incorporating the seasonal trend of the holiday effect to calculate the structural pattern of the PFC, providing useful suggestions for modeling practitioners.

articleTitle: The Energy and Environmental Efficiency Assessment of Energy System: A Case of Thailand’s Industry
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Power, Energy and Electrical Engineering (CPEEE)
abstract: Thailand’s industry is a prime sector that consumes a significant amount of energy throughout its supply chain and operations This paper aims to evaluate the energy and environmental efficiency of Thailand’s industry with the implementation of energy conservation measures to meet the national target of Energy Efficiency Plan 2018-2037 (EEP2018), Alternative Energy Development Plan 2018-2037 (AEDP2018), and Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs) targeting at the end of 2037. The efficiency evaluation shows a sustainability score, which consists of 11 indicators within three dimensions: energy, environmental, economic dimension. 4 Scenarios are studied; (1) BAU, (2) the implementation of high-efficiency equipment and energy conservation in designated factories, (3) the implementation of solar PV rooftop, and fuel switching in a boiler system, (4) the combination of scenario 2 and 3. 4 steps of the indicator scoring start from targeting, scoring, weighting, to aggregating. For Thai industry, the analysis shows that the energy score is at 78.99 in the BAU scenario and can be improved to 93.92 when implementing EEP2018 and AEDP2018 measures. Also, it suggests that the corresponding environmental score can be improved from 52.60 in BAU scenario to 80.62 in scenario 4. For BAU scenario, the economic score is shown as 55.75 and gets improved to 73.67 in scenario 4. Consequently, the sustainability score of Thai industry is summarized as 58.73. With the implementation of the EEP2018 measures, the industry can increase a score to 71.14, 21.27% higher than that of BAU. However, for scenario as an implementation of AEDP2018, it is shown that the sustainability score will decrease to 64.48. Then, the industry implements both EEP2018 and AEDP2018 measures, increasing a score to 79.86. In particular, the chemical sector can reach a perfect score of 100 in all three dimensions. This shows a great contribution to meet the national target and bring the sustainable development to the country. However, the non-metallic products sector reveals the lowest score but it can be improved by implementation of additional measures suitable for the industry such as carbon capture storage (CCS) in the cement industry, material substitution, and material efficiency, etc.

articleTitle: Identification Method of Energy Storage Operating Conditions based on Random Forest
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Power, Energy and Electrical Engineering (CPEEE)
abstract: Accurate and effective identification of the operating characteristics and application modes of electrochemical energy storage systems (EESS) is of great significance for the safe and reliable operation of large-scale EESS in power generation, transmission and distribution. The paper proposes a method for identifying the operating conditions of EESS based on the random forest algorithm. Analyzing and characterizing the typical operating conditions, such as frequency regulation, PV-EESS combination, Wind-EESS output schedule and smoothing, and peak shaving, the method introduces the random forest algorithm to build the identification model of EESS operating conditions. The variable importance measures, training model and test analysis have been completed. The results show that the method has an identification accuracy of more than 95% for the five typical operating conditions, which can effectively identify the EESS operating conditions.

articleTitle: Research on Non-Invasive Load Decomposition Based on Intelligent Measurement Data
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Power, Energy and Electrical Engineering (CPEEE)
abstract: With the deepening of the reform of the power system, the electricity sales side has gradually opened up, and various types of participants have emerged, such as service providers and integrators. These new entities can achieve the integration of small, scattered and flexible loads on the demand side, making the household load also. Being able to participate in demand response in the power market expands the scope of demand response capabilities. With the large-scale deployment and performance improvement of smart meters, more and more attention is paid to the non-metering functions of smart meters. How to mine and extract massive amounts of smart measurement data is also the current opportunity and challenge. This paper mainly aims at the problem of non-intrusive load decomposition in an environment with relatively tight computing resources, and proposes a non-intrusive load decomposition method based on edge load behavior labeling. A non-intrusive load decomposition method using load characteristics to modify integer planning is proposed to modify the optimal solution of the integrated planning problem, and a cloud, edge, and end-user synchronization computing framework combining 2-SAX and MIP-AC2S is proposed, which eases the data link The transmission pressure of road and cloud computing center.

articleTitle: Joint Dispatch of Peak Shaving and Frequency Response Considering Large-scale Electrochemical Energy Storage on the Grid Side
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Power, Energy and Electrical Engineering (CPEEE)
abstract: Application of large-scale electrochemical energy storage (LEES) on the grid side can improve flexibility and stability of power grid. In this paper, in view of the coordinated dispatch of peak shaving and frequency response of grid-side LEES, the multi-time scale coordinated dispatch problem is dealt with, and the joint dispatch model of conventional thermal generator units and LEES jointly participating in dual ancillary services is established. The model is solved by two-stage iteration method, and finally the coordinated regulation of conventional thermal generator units and LEES and the distribution of LEES’s output in dual ancillary services are realized. The example shows that the joint dispatch can not only effectively supplement the frequency response and peak shaving ability of power grid, but also improve the economy of system operation.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Identification and Diagnosis Technology of Substation Distribution Transformer Based on Improved Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Power, Energy and Electrical Engineering (CPEEE)
abstract: In this paper, a fault identification and diagnosis method of substation distribution transformer based on improved genetic algorithm was proposed. Firstly, the improved image recognition technology was used to extract the features of the collected images, and then the color and texture features of the feature images were extracted. The improved genetic algorithm was used to obtain the optimal weight value to further realize the fault identification and diagnosis of substation distribution transformer. What's more, the improved image recognition technology and the improved genetic algorithm were compared and verified, respectively. The results show that the improved image recognition technology can visually and intuitively display the abnormal conditions of equipment fault points, and can clearly reflect the essential characteristics of the images. The fault diagnosis accuracy of the improved genetic algorithm does not change with the increase of fault samples, and the accuracy can reach 97.5%. Finally, the fault identification and diagnosis system of substation distribution transformer was constructed and applied. The results show that based on the improved genetic algorithm, the error rate of the system is basically stable at about 0.8%, and can quickly approach the stable state. It has the advantages of short state adjustment time and fast adjustment speed.

articleTitle: Reliability Centered Weak Point Identification of Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Power, Energy and Electrical Engineering (CPEEE)
abstract: The existing methods for identifying weak points of reliability of distribution network components mainly rely on traditional analytical methods to establish reliability tracking models, but this method is only suitable for simple radiant distribution networks. When the scale of the distribution network expands, this method becomes very lengthy. In order to fill this gap, this paper proposes a Monte-Carlo-based method for identifying weak points of distribution network components. Firstly, considering the topological structure and distribution information of the distribution network, the Monte Carlo method is used to calculate the system reliability index of the distribution network. Then, through the component reliability tracking analysis, the influence factors of each component on the system reliability index are obtained, and the weak points of the system are determined by the size of the influence factors. Finally, a typical low-voltage distribution system with 10 load nodes is analyzed, and the weak components of the distribution network are found. The improvement measures to improve the reliability of the system are given. By comparing the improvement of the system reliability index before and after the weak point is modified, the validity of the weak point identification is verified.
